description: @lexical/mark's extensions: MarkExtension, MarkStateExtension and flavors made with defineMarkExtension (with MarkBaseExtension): the flavor-first $ functions, $getMarkIDsByFlavor, markableNodes, disabled, the markIDNodeKeys output, registerMarkIDsListener's reports, stateKey and attribute clashes, and registerMarkState's inserted-text rule (typing inside, at the edges of and between marked runs, replacing a selection from CONTROLLED_TEXT_INSERTION_COMMAND and PASTE_COMMAND, pasting nodes with ids, composition, hashtags, lists, Enter, Backspace, undo).
